name: Friid, Master of Gale
desc:
Friid is a Celtor NPC who acts as both progression for the Silentheart Oath and the Galebreathe trainer.

In order to obtain Galebreathe, you must bring five Gale Stones to Friid (2 if you have already obtained Galebreathe on a previous character). Alternatively, if you have obtained the Silentheart Oath, you must kill them in order to get one of five Oath Talents.
